comment: Art roles for the ride world. 'file' is where the real asset is expected (relative to assets/). When it is missing the game draws 'placeholder' in code. Replace a placeholder by dropping a file at 'file', or by pointing 'file' at an existing asset. Sizes are per frame; frames run left to right, rows top to bottom. See docs/RideWorld.md and docs/missing-assets.md.

roles.notes: Bike seen from behind (seat post, saddle, handlebar, derailleur) without wheels or rider. Layer 2 of 4, drawn over the wheel.
Rear tyre tread strip, tileable vertically - scrolled with the wheel angle (rear view). For a side-on wheel instead, set motion 'rotate' and 'spokes' in rider.json and draw the whole wheel.

Legs from behind. Row 0: seated pedalling, frame 0 = right crank at 12 o'clock, then clockwise (seen from the right) in equal steps. Row 1: out of the saddle, same phases. Row 2: column 0 coasting (cranks level), column 1 idle (one foot down). Minimum 8 frames per revolution, 12 recommended.
Back, arms to the bars, helmet. Drawn last; shifted up 7 px out of the saddle (rider.json outOfSaddleOffsetY).
OPTIONAL alternative to the four layers: one flat sheet (whole bike + rider per frame), same rows as rider_legs. Only used when assets/World/Rider/rider.json has kind 'sheet'.
Soft shadow under the rider, stretched to the bike's footprint. Mapped to the existing character shadow.
Conifer, 3 variants. Camera-facing billboard, base at the bottom centre.
Deciduous tree, 3 variants.
Palm, 3 variants (coastal).
Desert cactus, 2 variants.
Low shrub, 3 variants.
Boulder, 3 variants.
Grass tuft, 3 variants; drawn only near the road.
Roadside sign on a post, 2 variants (no real place names or brands).
One 4 m guardrail section with posts at both ends. Drawn as a quad along the road on the outside of bends.
Street lamp; the lamp head overhangs to the left (towards the road on the right-hand side).
House / small building front, 3 variants; faces the road.
Banner spanning the road on two poles (workout complete). Poles at the far left and right edges.
Sun disc with glow, additive.
Moon disc, alpha blended.
Star field, tileable both ways; mapped around the sky by heading and elevation. Alpha = brightness.
Cloud billboard, tinted by the sky. Mapped to the existing particle cloud.
Far mountain silhouette, white on transparent (tinted per biome), tileable horizontally. Parallax layer 1.
Nearer hills silhouette, white on transparent, tileable horizontally. Parallax layer 2.
Detail texture multiplied over the vertex colour; keep it near-grey/neutral.
Detail texture for steep slopes.
Detail texture for snow.
Detail texture for sand / beaches.
Water surface detail, scrolled slowly; multiplied with the biome's water colour.
Asphalt detail, multiplied with the biome's road colour; tiled every 4 m.
Paint texture inside the lines (the line pattern itself is computed in the shader).
Rain streak frames. Mapped to the existing particle sheet.
Snowflake frames. Mapped to the existing particle sheet.
